q_dose1.text: On day 208 after birth, the patient received an intravenous infusion of k-abe at a total RNA dose of 0.1 mg per kilogram.

q_escalation.text: Given the incomplete biochemical correction in the patient — and according to the clinical protocol — he received a second dose of k-abe (0.3 mg per kilogram) 22 days after receipt of the first k-abe infusion.

q_cough.text: The patient had a coughing episode during the second infusion that resolved with nasal suctioning.

q_halve.text: At 2 weeks after the second infusion, the patient was able to receive a reduced dose of glycerol phenylbutyrate to half the starting dose (from 10.1 to 5.0 ml per square meter per day) without unacceptable adverse effects.

q_illness.text: he recovered from the viral infections without a hyperammonemic crisis and was able to continue his full-protein diet during the course of his illnesses.

q_iv_dose.text: Receive a single IV dose of 0.1 mg/kg LNP.CPS1.Q335X.

q_redose_rule.text: A repeat escalated dose (0.3 mg/kg) of LNP.CPS1.Q335X will be considered if: a. The initial dose was safe and well tolerated, AND b. The patient still demonstrates biochemical features of CPS1 deficiency requiring protein-restricted diet and/or ammonia scavenger medications.

q_committee.text: All data collected up to Day 21 will be reviewed, and a decision to re-dose will be made by a multidisciplinary clinical committee of experts including metabolic physicians, hepatologists, metabolic dieticians, immunologists, and ethicists

q_max3.text: A maximum of three total doses will be provided. There must be a minimum of 21 days between doses.

q_escalation_options.text: If the previous dose(s) were well tolerated, the clinical team can increase the dose of LNP.CPS1.Q335X to 0.3 mg/kg (second dose) or repeat a 0.3 mg/kg or 0.45mg/kg dose (third dose).

q_methylpred.text: The patient will be administered one dose of methylprednisone (IV, 1 mg/kg) immediately prior to drug product infusion (on Day 0).

q_batch_measured.text: The clinical batch of the drug product had an average hydrodynamic diameter of 73 nm with a polydispersity index of 0.07 as determined by dynamic light scattering, 97% total mRNA encapsulation by the RiboGreen fluorescence assay, and a gRNA/mRNA ratio of 1.1 as measured by ultra-performance liquid chromatography (UPLC)-based determinations
